title: Action de Galois sur Teichmüller : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. U_{0,3} = P^1 - {0,1,infinity} is drawn on the Riemann sphere. The real equator carries the three punctures R_0, R_1, R_infinity, and the midpoints Q_i of the opposite equatorial arcs (Q_infinity = 1/2, etc.). The poles P_+ and P_- are the centres of the upper and lower half-planes. This is the barycentric subdivision of the 'carte' (map) given by the equator with three vertices. It has 12 flag-triangles D_r = P_eps Q_i R_{omega i}, indexed by r = (i, omega, eps).

The symmetry group Gamma_0 = S_3 x {1, tau} (tau = complex conjugation) has order 12 and acts simply transitively on these flags. The standard flag is (infinity, +, +).

For each flag v = (i, omega, eps) there is a unique u_v in Gamma_0 taking the standard flag to v. It induces an isomorphism psi_i^{omega,eps} = pi_1(u_v; Q_infinity) from Pi_{0,3} to Pi_i = pi_1(U, Q_i). These are what the previous page calls 'épinglages' (pinnings). Pi_{0,3} = pi_1(U, Q_infinity) is identified with pi_1(U, P_+) via the standard path d_infinity^+.

The flags with the same Q_i differ by right multiplication by the stabiliser of Q_infinity, which is the Klein group <sigma_infinity, tau>. Hence psi_{v g_0} = psi_v o pi_1(g_0). Also u_v g_0 u_v^{-1} = tau when g_0 = tau, because tau is central (it commutes with the real Möbius maps). And u_v g_0 u_v^{-1} = sigma_i, the transposition fixing i, when g_0 = sigma_infinity. This gives formula (39):
- psi^{omega,eps'} = tau o psi^{omega,eps} = psi^{omega,eps} o tau_infinity.
- psi^{omega',eps'} = sigma_i o psi^{omega,eps} = psi^{omega,eps} o sigma_infinity.

Here sigma_i is holomorphic: it is the half-turn about the axis R_i Q_i, e.g. z -> 1 - z for i = infinity. It swaps the two hemispheres, hence flips both omega and eps.

Composing gives (40): psi^{omega',eps} = sigma~_i o psi = psi o sigma~_infinity, with sigma~_i = tau sigma_i. For i = infinity this is z -> 1 - z̄, the antiholomorphic reflection in the great circle through P_eps, P_eps', Q_i (and R_i).

Purpose. This prepares the explicit description of the action of Gamma_0, and later of Galois and Teichmüller groupoids, on fundamental groups of U_{0,3} with several base points.

The last paragraph is a methodological self-criticism. He has privileged P_eps and Q_i as base points 'by old habit'. The truly crucial base points for the intended work are the R_i^omega, i.e. tangential base points at the punctures with a direction omega. These make monodromy around the 'holes' R_i directly visible. The next page carries this out: it uses the real oriented blow-up (the 'trace' on Sigma~ of each flag-triangle becomes a quadrilateral P Q R^omega S^eps), and regions Sigma~_r made of D_r and its three reflections.
errors: No mathematical error found. The formulas are consistent: tau is central in Gamma_0, and conjugating sigma_infinity by u_v gives sigma_i. The superscripts in (40) are right: tau flips eps, sigma_i flips both omega and eps, so tau sigma_i flips only omega. tau and sigma_i commute, so the order of composition does not matter.

Notation is slightly loose. tau_infinity and sigma_infinity mean pi_1(tau; Q_infinity) and pi_1(sigma_infinity; Q_infinity) acting on Pi_{0,3}. On the left, tau and sigma_i mean the induced automorphisms of pi_1(U, Q_i). Both are well defined because Q_i is fixed by both maps. Applying pi_1 to the antiholomorphic tau is implicitly allowed.

ideas.what: Simply transitive action of S_3 x Z/2 (with complex conjugation) on the 12 flags of the barycentric subdivision of P^1(C) cut along P^1(R), and the induced pinnings psi_i^{omega,eps} between fundamental groups at different base points
ideas.modern_name: Dessin/map automorphisms acting on flags; fundamental groupoid with several base points; 'pinnings' (épinglages) of Pi_{0,3}
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (Esquisse d'un programme, 1984); later formalised in the dessins d'enfants literature
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (barycentric subdivision of maps, flags, the cartographic group); the explicit formulas here are unpublished

ideas.what: Formulas psi_{v g} = psi_v o pi_1(g) = pi_1(u_v g u_v^{-1}) o psi_v for g in the stabiliser <tau, sigma_infinity> of Q_infinity
ideas.modern_name: Equivariance of path transport under the automorphism group of P^1 - {0,1,infinity}
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard; it appears in Ihara and in Lochak-Schneps-type treatments of S_3 x Z/2 acting on pi_1 of P^1 - {0,1,infinity}

ideas.what: Recognition that tangential base points R_i^omega at the punctures (with real direction omega) are the right base points for monodromy around the holes, instead of interior points P_eps and Q_i
ideas.modern_name: Tangential base points; real oriented blow-up at punctures
ideas.usually_credited_to: Deligne (1989, 'Le groupe fondamental de la droite projective moins trois points'); Ihara
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme alludes to base points 'at infinity' and the Teichmüller tower, but the explicit tangential-base-point construction is generally credited to Deligne

missed.claim: Documentary evidence, in notes dated 'from 1978', that Grothendieck consciously switched from interior base points to tangential base points at the punctures (R_i^omega). The next page realises these via a blow-up-like 'trace' quadrilateral. This anticipates the usage standardised by Deligne (1989) and Ihara. It is a priority detail, not a new theorem.
missed.quote: j'ai privilégié les P_ε et les Q_i comme pts base - alors que pour le travail que j'ai en vue, ce sont les points R_i^ω qui sont les plus cruciaux
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Of historical interest for crediting the tangential-base-point viewpoint in the Grothendieck-Teichmüller programme. Mathematically it is now standard.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a routine computation of how the 12-element symmetry group acts on pinned fundamental groups, plus a remark switching to tangential base points. The only slightly notable point is the early, explicit preference for base points at the punctures, which is now standard (Deligne/Ihara).
transcription_corrections: Previous page: 'épi-gluings' should almost certainly read 'épinglages' (pinnings); 'gestes' is probably 'gestes' or 'germes' — unclear.
This page, first line: 'Or dans le cas g_0 = τ_∞ resp. g_0 = σ_∞' — the left-margin fragment reads 'int(τ_∞), int(σ_∞)' (inner automorphisms); the struck word is 'donc'.
In (40), the struck symbol before σ̃_i appears to be a stray 'ε' or 'τ', replaced by σ̃_i with the gloss 'τσ_i'.

Final paragraph: the phrase rendered 'les calculs plus ou moins en pt compliqués directement' is uncertain. It plausibly reads 'et les calculs faits ici ne pt [peuvent] expliciter directement les phénomènes de "monodromie"' — the sense is that the present calculations do not directly exhibit monodromy around the holes.
